QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] The Solution is Dissolution 3
QuestInfo.0: You've almost reached the end of the Vanishing Journey. Follow Rino to the end of the cave.
QuestInfo.1: You can melt Slaws with Tranquil Solvent. You need 10 Tranquil Solvents to melt the mass of Slaws. You can get Tranquil Solvent from Tranquil Erdas and Lantern Erdas that live in the cave.
QuestInfo.2: The path opened when you sprinkled the Tranquil Solvent over the Slaws blocking the tunnel.

0.0: There are more Slaws blocking the way here. This is the worst we've seen yet.
0.1: We're almost at the end now! Just a little farther... Can you gather 30 Tranquil Solvents this time?

yes.0: Once you've gathered 30 Tranquil Solvents, go to the Slaws blocking the way and sprinkle it over them.

no.0: We can't go any further like this.

1.0: #b(You sprinkle the Tranquil Solvent over Slaw. It wails as it dissolves, opening the way forward.)#k

npc.0: Go to the Slaws blocking the way and sprinkle the solvent over them.

item.0: #b(You need 10 Tranquil Solvents to completely melt the Slaws blocking the way.)#k
